## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small and does one thing.
- [ ] I added or updated tests.
- [ ] `swift test` passes (and `npm test` in `vscode-ext/` if I changed the extension).
- [ ] `node design/check-sprites.js` and `node design/check-skin.js` pass (if I changed sprites or skins).
- [ ] `python3 scripts/remote/test_hook.py` passes (if I changed `scripts/remote/`).
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal paths or private data in the diff.
